author: Epic Games
description:
The Greymane's Journey, Enhanced. Discover an enhanced Crimson Desert, featuring new story moments and expanded voice-over and language support.

Begin the adventure loved by millions, refined since launch with a wealth of updates, including new content, mounts, pets, customization options, various quality-of-life improvements, and more.

Crimson Desert Enhanced is a free update for all owners of the base game.

Crimson Desert is available for 20% off for a limited time on the Epic Games Store: https://epic.gm/crimson-desert

RECLAIM POWER. REACH BEYOND.

About Crimson Desert  

Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent.
